title: Jonah and the Weather
author: Oscar Galloway
blurb: Ines Quintana, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
